visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand wearing a purple glove uses a round mesh strainer to scoop golden-brown, crispy fried chicken out of a metal deep fryer. The setting is bright with direct overhead lighting. (2) Close-up of a wire basket holding bright yellow, thick-cut sweet potato fries. The environment is an outdoor street food stall. (3) A female worker with a pink floral headscarf, a striped shirt, and a mask is seen behind a counter filled with various fried snacks, including wings and legs. She uses a squeeze bottle to season the food. (4) Wide shot of the '亨旺炸雞' stall under a green awning on a city street. A black scooter and some red mats are visible on the ground. (5) Close-up of a hand holding a large fried chicken leg with a thick, textured crust. The meat inside is white and juicy. (6) A worker shakes fried pieces in a metal bowl while adding red chili powder. (7) A hand pulls apart a fried chicken wing, showing the steam and moist texture of the meat inside. (8) Four sweet potato fries are held up on wooden sticks, showing a crispy exterior. (9) A close-up of the paper bag containing fried chicken skin being picked up with wooden chopsticks. (10) A view of the price menu board showing various fried items and their costs in Chinese. (11) A man wearing a white t-shirt with 'NAVY' on the back walks past the stall at the end of the video.
